text_blocks.snippet: To calculate your Debt-to-Income (DTI) ratio, divide your total monthly debt payments by your gross monthly income. The result, expressed as a percentage, indicates how much of your income goes towards debt obligations.
Here's how to calculate your DTI ratio:

list.title: 1. Calculate your total monthly debt payments:

list.snippet: Include all recurring monthly debts like mortgage or rent payments, car loans, student loans, credit card minimum payments, and other loan payments.
For credit cards, use the minimum payment, not your full balance.
Include payments for co-signed loans or joint accounts.
